script.speaker: student
script.text: How much is a ticket to the city centre?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: For students it is nine lira with a card.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I don't have a card. I have cash.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then it is twelve lira.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, here you are.

question.stem: How much does the student pay?
question.explain_tr: Öğrencinin kartı yok, bu yüzden dokuz lira değil on iki lira ödüyor.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Our Monday class starts at nine, not at ten.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Nine? That is very early for me.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Yes. The room is free only in the morning.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, I write it in my notebook.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Good. Please tell your friends too.

question.stem: When does the Monday class start?
question.explain_tr: Öğretmen dersin dokuzda başladığını söylüyor. 'not at ten' kısmı onda olmadığını anlatıyor.
question.key_line: Our Monday class starts at nine, not at ten.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Excuse me, where is room twelve?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It is on this floor, next to the lift.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Thank you. Is the class there now?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, your class starts at two o'clock.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then I can drink a tea first.

question.explain_tr: Görevli odanın aynı katta, asansörün yanında olduğunu söylüyor.
question.key_line: It is on this floor, next to the lift.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I have the wifi password, please?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It is on the yellow card. Small letters, no spaces.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is the internet free for students?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, but only inside this building.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, thank you very much.

question.stem: Where can the student use the free internet?
question.explain_tr: Görevli internetin ücretsiz olduğunu ama sadece bu binada çalıştığını söylüyor.
question.key_line: Yes, but only inside this building.

script.speaker: student
script.text: One cheese sandwich, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: With tomato or without tomato? The bread is fresh today.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Without tomato, please. I don't like tomato.

script.speaker: student
script.text: And one small water, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Okay. Together it is twenty-five lira.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Here you are.

question.stem: What does the student NOT want in the sandwich?
question.explain_tr: Öğrenci domates istemiyor. Peynir ve ekmek sandviçin içinde, su ise ayrı bir sipariş.

script.speaker: student
script.text: What time does the library close today?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: At six. On Friday we close at eight.

script.speaker: student
script.text: And on Sunday?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: On Sunday the library is closed.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The reading room upstairs is open until six too.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, I come tomorrow morning.

question.stem: What time does the library close today?
question.explain_tr: Bugün altıda kapanıyor. Sekiz saati cuma günü için söyleniyor, pazar günü ise kapalı.
question.key_line: At six. On Friday we close at eight.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I lost my phone charger in this room.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: What colour is it?

script.speaker: student
script.text: It is white and very small.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We have one white charger here. Is this yours?

script.speaker: student
script.text: Yes! Thank you very much.

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci beyaz ve küçük bir şarj aleti kaybettiğini söylüyor. Telefonunu değil.
question.key_line: It is white and very small.

script.speaker: student
script.text: When is the gym open in the morning?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: From seven to eleven. Then it closes for cleaning.

script.speaker: student
script.text: And in the afternoon?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It opens again at two and closes at nine.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Good, I come after my class.

question.stem: When does the gym close in the morning?
question.explain_tr: Sabah yediden on bire açık; on birde temizlik için kapanıyor. İkide tekrar açılıyor.
question.key_line: From seven to eleven. Then it closes for cleaning.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How much is one photocopy?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: One lira for black, three lira for colour.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I need ten black copies.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That is ten lira. Do you want them now?

script.speaker: student
script.text: Yes, please. I wait here.

question.stem: How much does the student pay?
question.explain_tr: On siyah fotokopi, tanesi bir lira, toplam on lira. Üç lira renkli fotokopinin fiyatı.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Where are you? I am at the gate.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I am in the library. I come in five minutes.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Okay. I wait near the coffee machine.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Please buy me a small coffee.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Okay, but bring money. I have only ten lira.

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş kahve makinesinin yanında bekliyor. Kütüphanede olan kişi öğrencinin kendisi.
question.key_line: I wait near the coffee machine.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Do you have big notebooks?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes. Blue, red and green.

script.speaker: student
script.text: One blue, please. And two pens.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The notebook is fifteen lira, the pens are ten.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Thank you. Do you need a bag?

script.speaker: student
script.text: No, thank you. My bag is here.

options.A: One blue notebook and two pens

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci bir mavi defter ve iki kalem alıyor. Kırmızı ve yeşil sadece seçenek olarak geçiyor.
question.key_line: One blue, please. And two pens.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Is it cold outside?

script.speaker: student
script.text: Not very cold, but it rains.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Then I take my umbrella.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Take a jacket too. The wind is strong.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The bus stop has no roof today.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Okay. See you at school.

question.explain_tr: Yağmur yağıyor ve rüzgâr sert. Hava çok soğuk değil, kar da yok.
question.key_line: Not very cold, but it rains.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I want to see the doctor.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Today is full. Can you come on Thursday?

script.speaker: student
script.text: Thursday is good. What time?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: At half past ten. Bring your student card.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay. Thursday at half past ten.

question.explain_tr: Randevu perşembe, saat on buçukta. 'Half past ten' sabahı gösteriyor, bugün ise dolu.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is the cafeteria on this floor?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, it is downstairs, near the garden door.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is it open now?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, until three o'clock.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The soup today is tomato soup.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Good. I am very hungry.

question.explain_tr: Kafeterya bu katta değil; alt katta ve bahçe kapısının yanında.
question.key_line: No, it is downstairs, near the garden door.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I borrow a pen? Mine is empty.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: I have a blue one and a black one.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The black one, please. I write the answers.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Okay, but give it back after the class.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Of course. Thank you.

question.stem: Which pen does the student take?
question.explain_tr: Öğrenci siyah kalemi istiyor. Mavi kalem de var ama onu almıyor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Which bus goes to the station?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Number twelve. It comes every ten minutes.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is number eight good too?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, number eight goes to the hospital.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The stop is in front of this building.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, I take number twelve.

question.stem: Which bus goes to the station?
question.explain_tr: İstasyona on iki numara gidiyor. Sekiz numara hastaneye gidiyor.
question.key_line: Number twelve. It comes every ten minutes.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How much is a bottle of water?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Small water is five lira, big water is eight.

script.speaker: student
script.text: And orange juice?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Orange juice is fifteen lira.

script.speaker: student
script.text: One big water, please. Juice is expensive.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Here you are. Eight lira.

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci büyük su alıyor. Portakal suyunu pahalı bulduğu için almıyor.
